```python
# Unit test for function digits
def test_digits():
    # Single odd digit
    assert digits(1) == 1
    assert digits(3) == 3
    assert digits(7) == 7

    # Single even digit -> no odd digits, return 0
    assert digits(4) == 0
    assert digits(0) == 0
    assert digits(8) == 0

    # Mixed digits: only odd digits contribute to product
    assert digits(235) == 15      # 3 * 5
    assert digits(123456) == 15   # 1 * 3 * 5
    assert digits(2468) == 0      # all even

    # Repeated odd digits
    assert digits(111) == 1
    assert digits(999) == 729
    assert digits(333) == 27

    # Digit 1 is odd and multiplies as identity
    assert digits(12) == 1
    assert digits(1246) == 1

    # Larger numbers
    assert digits(579) == 315     # 5 * 7 * 9
    assert digits(1202468) == 1   # only odd digit is 1

    print("All tests passed!")

test_digits()
```
